SEARCH
Package utils

Class AudioUtils

java.lang.Object
utils.AudioUtils
public class AudioUtils extends Object
Utility class for audio format conversions between bytes and floating-point samples. This class provides static methods for converting audio data between byte representation (typically used for I/O and storage) and floating-point representation (used for audio processing and manipulation). It supports multiple bit depths (16-bit and 32-bit PCM) and handles both big-endian and little-endian byte ordering.

Audio Format Support:

  • 16-bit PCM_SIGNED: Range -32768 to 32767 (converted to -1.0 to 1.0)
  • 32-bit PCM_FLOAT: Range -1.0 to 1.0 (native floating-point)

Exception Handling:

  • AudioConversionException - For format conversion errors (null arrays, buffer size mismatches)
  • IllegalArgumentException - For invalid parameter values (negative counts, unsupported bit depths)

Byte Order Support:

  • Little-Endian (default for most audio formats, e.g., WAV on Windows)
  • Big-Endian (used in some audio formats, e.g., AIFF)

Validation Features:

  • Null array detection
  • Buffer size validation
  • Bit depth support verification
  • Invalid value handling (NaN, Infinity)
  • Audio clipping prevention via sample clamping

Usage Example: 


 try {
     // Convert 4096 bytes of 16-bit little-endian audio to floats
     byte[] audioBytes = new byte[4096];
     float[] floatSamples = new float[2048];
     AudioUtils.bytesToFloats(audioBytes, floatSamples, 4096, 16, false);
     
     // Process samples and convert back
     byte[] outputBytes = new byte[4096];
     AudioUtils.floatsToBytes(floatSamples, outputBytes, 2048, 16, false);
 } catch (AudioConversionException e) {
     logger.error("Conversion failed: {}", e.getMessage());
 }

  • Method Details

    • bytesToFloats

      public static void bytesToFloats(byte[] input, float[] output, int bytesRead, int bitDepth, boolean isBigEndian) throws AudioConversionException
      Converts audio data from byte format to floating-point format.

      This method reads audio samples from a byte buffer and converts them to normalized floating-point values in the range [-1.0, 1.0].

      Parameters:
      input - byte array containing raw audio data
      output - float array where converted samples will be stored
      bytesRead - number of bytes to read from input
      bitDepth - bit depth of audio data (16 or 32)
      isBigEndian - true for big-endian, false for little-endian
      Throws:
      AudioConversionException - if conversion parameters are invalid
      IllegalArgumentException - if bytesRead is not multiple of (bitDepth / 8)

    • floatsToBytes

      public static void floatsToBytes(float[] input, byte[] output, int samplesCount, int bitDepth, boolean isBigEndian) throws AudioConversionException
      Converts audio data from floating-point format to byte format.

      This method reads normalized floating-point audio samples in the range [-1.0, 1.0] and converts them to byte representation.

      Parameters:
      input - float array containing normalized audio samples [-1.0, 1.0]
      output - byte array where converted data will be stored
      samplesCount - number of float samples to convert
      bitDepth - bit depth for output data (16 or 32)
      isBigEndian - true for big-endian, false for little-endian
      Throws:
      AudioConversionException - if conversion parameters are invalid
      IllegalArgumentException - if samplesCount is negative
